latest.title: Uniform-in-time relative entropy estimates for Kac's approximation of the Landau equation
latest.abstract: We prove uniform-in-time quantitative relative entropy estimates for Kac's particle approximation of the three-dimensional spatially homogeneous Landau equation for Maxwellian molecules. Using the relative entropy method and logarithmic derivative estimates, we obtain a finite-time normalized entropy bound of order $N^{-1/2}$. The proof relies on explicit covariance identities and a new law-of-large-numbers estimate for the particle system using a new duality method. The uniform-in-time propagation of chaos is derived from an interpolation with an algebraic relaxation estimate toward equilibrium.
latest.workSummary: 论文研究 Maxwellian molecules 的 Kac 系统到空间齐次 Landau 方程的有限时间相对熵估计，并证明均匀时间传播混沌。
latest.breakthrough: Theorem 1.1 给出有限时间相对熵界，Sections 5–6 将其升级为 uniform-in-time propagation of chaos。
latest.limitations: 依赖 entropy solution、初始矩/熵条件和 Maxwellian molecules 核；均匀时间结论受文中一致性条件限制。

steps.claim: Section 3 建立 Kac 系统相对熵的微分恒等式。
steps.route: 对相对熵测试 Kac 生成元，利用 Landau 碰撞结构和交换对称性分离耗散项与误差项。
steps.evidence: PDF 第11–15页，第3.1节 Evolution of the relative entropy。

steps.claim: Section 4 控制经验碰撞项与 Landau 极限误差。
steps.route: 用 law-of-large-numbers estimates、矩控制和相对熵耗散界估计粒子系统与极限方程间的偏差。
steps.evidence: PDF 第16–23页，第4节 Law-of-large-numbers estimates。

steps.claim: Theorem 1.1 及 Section 6 的均匀传播混沌由 Gronwall 收束。
steps.route: 将熵微分不等式积分并用 Gronwall 得有限时间界；再以 uniform-in-time 估计和边缘分布一致性证明 propagation of chaos。
steps.evidence: PDF 第3–6页，第1.3节 Theorem 1.1；第24页起第5节 Proof of Theorem 1.1；第26–34页第6节 Uniform-in-time propagation of chaos。
